mandatory_gates_in_order: The event is CHANGED, every supported visible field is resolved and unchanged except muted_badge false to true, and the joint-state alternatives are unchanged.
The candidate is one maximal nonempty muted_badge ambiguous run with exact reason partial muted badge; unreadable frames are never redraws.
Every claimed frame is product-unresolved solely in muted_badge against the current target.
Two immediate readable false supports precede and two immediate readable true supports follow the run.
The authenticated recording-wide maximum source interval is retained exactly and is no greater than the 1 s sanity ceiling; it does not loosen a candidate chain.

Video and source indices are consecutive, every gap is no greater than the smaller of the verified recording-wide maximum and the fixed 10 ms support-chain maximum, and the full support chain spans at most 50 ms.
The expectation-blind badge probe exactly reproduces each raw state from lit_fraction and p95 and retains the fixed 2 by 4 max-channel-median profile.
Every one of the eight endpoint profile components rises by at least 20 intensity levels.
Every component stays within normalized progress -0.15 through 1.15, has no backward step over 0.10, and has no more than 0.15 total backward motion.
The record affects muted_badge only, changes no raw observation, and is usable only through an exact product-policy allowlist entry.

scope.claim: A maximal raw badge refusal is a coherent captured rising fill between stable unmuted and muted states.
does_not_claim: a value for any ambiguous frame

validation.observer_eligibility_rule: COHERENT_BADGE_RISING_FILL with BOTH_CLEAR endpoints, RISING direction, and HIGH confidence
